case.query_zh: 以2025-05-31为资料可得截止日，请提供Microsoft公司整体收入：单季度 2025-01-01 至 2025-03-31、单季度 2024-01-01 至 2024-03-31、累计期间 2024-07-01 至 2025-03-31、累计期间 2023-07-01 至 2024-03-31。保留各项金额单位、精确起止和原文出处，说明哪些是单季度、哪些是九个月累计；只使用所选10-Q，不使用截止日之后发布的材料。

necessary_context.information: unit/scale and quarter versus nine-month column headings, including comparative year alignment
necessary_context.acceptance: original table header or another equivalent exact source span; records can additionally carry original XBRL context dates; source reporting period alone is insufficient

necessary_context.information: reported company-wide scope and source identity; USD and scale=6 exact fact provenance
necessary_context.acceptance: validated undimensioned original XBRL facts and source metadata/locators, with original visible amount and sufficient table context; no requirement to copy boilerplate cover text

optional.information: product/services breakdown directly explaining the total revenue row in the same table
optional.constraint: not required and cannot compensate for any missing required total or period

unnecessary: multiple equivalent disclosure tables for the same four facts without an interpretive need
unrequested profit, expenses, segment metrics or management commentary
full filing or whole chapter where the revenue table and context suffice
redundancy.structural_context: A necessary intact table may carry unrelated rows. Disclose them separately as structural excess; do not treat extra rows as necessary answer content. Do not use minimum characters or one mandatory block ID as the criterion.
redundancy.focus_pass: one sufficient coherent original occurrence per fact with its necessary context; bounded intact-table excess is explicitly allowed, duplicated unrelated tables require explanation

evaluation_axes.necessary_coverage: R1-R4 individually plus C1/C2; optional score cannot offset missing required information
evaluation_axes.focus: semantic relevance and repeated equivalent occurrences, with structural excess separated from optional useful evidence

equivalent_evidence_policy: Multiple equivalent original spans permitted; listed occurrences are reviewed examples, not the only allowable evidence. Valid original XBRL context metadata can establish precise starts. Record query receipts alone do not prove original table-body delivery.
failure_history: retain first attempts, errors and any later criteria revision; no post-result silent relaxation
runtime_isolation: This file, expected answers, precise occurrence inventory and review criticism must not enter the system Agent input.
